name: tom-secrets-build-docs
description: The documentation tooling of the Tom Secrets Manager's manual CI: the :docs check (Mermaid sources rendered, links, line lengths, the exported diagrams current, the configuration reference complete) and the diagram export to SVG and PNG in the project's website style.
author: Peter Nicolai Alexis Kyaw

scripts.build: node --check tool/check_docs.mjs && node --check tool/render_diagrams.mjs && node --check tool/docs_lib.mjs && node --check tool/mermaid_render.mjs && node --check tool/check_configuration.mjs && node --check tool/config_lib.mjs
